None of these is shown by either paper to be sufficient.

The reverse fails (P-3 inside P-82's 0.641-0.933; two-sample z = 1.12), so condition 4 holds only under its one-directional wording, resting on 20 of 24 test subjects. results.reason: No condition fails on the printed figures. The record's 94.61% is P-72's AD-vs-NC accuracy (condition 6), and correcting it reverses the direction of the claimed gap: P-72 is lower, not higher. On the printed pMCI-vs-sMCI figures, P-72's 77.19% (three-test-subset mean; its five-fold CV repeat also gives 77.19%, AUC 0.762) and its sMRI-only 73.68% lie outside P-122's interval (0.795-0.881), and P-72's AUC 0.755 lies outside P-122's HM interval (0.814-0.906).
